candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this names a permit-incorporated reporting obligation for the pretreatment program affects which monitoring/reporting requirements are in scope for FY2025 (B) and how missing or incomplete pretreatment status evidence is classified (C).

Interpretation of whether maintaining or updating an SIU list is a required pretreatment activity changes the set of applicable monitoring/reporting obligations (B) and whether absent SIU documentation reflects a required-but-unmet obligation versus another no-data state (C).

The categorical-determination column indicates whether an industrial user is subject to categorical pretreatment standards; different readings of what must be recorded here change which numeric limits and monitoring categories are treated as applicable (A,B).

This column heading denotes a 90-day compliance reporting/monitoring category for significant industrial users; whether it is operative affects which periodic monitoring obligations are counted as required (B) and how gaps in 90-day compliance documentation are semantically classified (C).

This fragment labels the semi-annual self-monitoring report column; interpreting whether it imposes self-monitoring duties on significant industrial users changes applicable monitoring obligations (B) and missing-evidence semantics when self-monitoring results are absent (C).

The annual monitoring column identifies a recurring monitoring obligation type for listed users; interpreting its scope or applicability changes FY2025 monitoring-requirement results (B) and the treatment of periods lacking annual monitoring evidence (C).

The effluent-limits column signals that numeric discharge limits may be associated with listed users; interpreting whether limits recorded here are enforceable and comparison-ready changes limit-applicability analysis (A) and whether limit-related monitoring is required (B).

The compliance-status field governs how SIU compliance is documented in the status report; different readings affect which monitoring or reporting outcomes count as established versus unresolved (B,C).

This column header fragment denotes times-sampled tracking for significant industrial users; whether sampling frequency is an enforceable obligation changes required-monitoring results (B) and how intervals without documented samples are classified (C).
